Lucide 1.66.0, the icon font of the npm package lucide-static (ISC)
https://lucide.dev, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

font/lucide.ttf as the package ships it: the editor's icons, built into it
(cmake/embed_file.cmake) and merged into its font. The codepoints the editor
uses are in projects/editor/include/bubble/editor/editor_icons.hpp, read from
the package's font/info.json. LICENSE is the package's: ISC, and MIT for the
icons that came from Feather.
